Připravenost (20–100 %) = odchylka HRV,: Readiness (20–100%) = how far HRV, resting heart rate (last night and the 7-night average) and sleep from your watch sit from your 8-week norm. The check-in counts towards the Score only under Symptoms, but the Training recommendation still uses it. HRV and resting heart rate each about one of your usual day-to-day swings off the norm → around 70%, almost two → around 40%. Below 65% no hard training or long run today, below 45% recovery only; it also lowers today's single-run ceiling. After today's session it drops by how demanding the session was against your usual days; it doesn't lower the ceilings again (what you ran is deducted anyway), it only decides whether another hard session still makes sense today. During the day the day outside training lowers it too: movement above your usual day (by at most 8 points) and raised resting heart rate. It doesn't change the weekly target from the cycle.
